hints.title: Prefix Sum Modulo Congruence Property
hints.text: A subarray sum is a multiple of k if the cumulative prefix sum modulo k produces an identical remainder at two indices at least two steps apart.

hints.title: Remainder Pair Distance Invariant
hints.text: If prefix[j] % k == prefix[i] % k with j - i >= 2, the elements from index i + 1 through j sum to a multiple of k.

hints.title: First Modulo Remainder Index Check Procedure
hints.text: Maintain running total modulo k and store the first occurrence index in a lookup table seeded with remainder zero at index -1. If current remainder is seen previously and index distance is at least two, return true. Otherwise record new remainders.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input element count or target integer bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(min(N, K)) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Computing all subarray sums takes O(N^2) time, which times out for N = 100,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking at most min(N, k) distinct remainders in a lookup table operates in O(N) time with O(min(N, k)) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle the minimum subarray length requirement of 2 and initialize remainder 0 at index -1.
